quarterly_data.quarter: Union Tool annual securities report: FY2025 (03-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 (January-December 2025): net sales JPY 40,165 million (+23.2% YoY), a record; operating profit JPY 8,728 million (+26.9%) and profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 6,114 million (+15.7%), both records; ordinary profit JPY 8,136 million (+14.1%). Management states that despite the cost of large-scale capex and building up increased production, higher sales of high-profit high-value-added tools and tools for high-layer-count boards lifted profitability; with a weaker-than-assumed yen at year-end, actual results beat the forecast disclosed at the end of Q3 by 7.1% in net sales and 10.5% in operating profit.
quarterly_data.figure: net sales JPY 40,165 million (+23.2%); operating profit JPY 8,728 million (+26.9%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Union Tool annual securities report: FY2025 (03-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 segments: Japan net sales (including intersegment) JPY 25,906 million (+15.5%), segment profit JPY 4,214 million (-15.5%); the Nagaoka Plant, the production base for high-value-added tools, focused on large-scale capex plus plant infrastructure work to build up increased production; Asia excluding Japan net sales JPY 24,259 million (+33.0%), segment profit JPY 3,150 million (+107.7%), as demand for package substrates and high-layer-count boards used in AI servers and data centers grew mainly in China and Taiwan and higher utilisation of local production bases sharply improved profitability; North America JPY 2,037 million (+0.9%); Europe JPY 2,527 million (+12.8%). Management states the AI-related field, centred on package substrates and high-layer-count boards for AI servers and data centers, clearly led the market, while logic and memory demand stayed limited and automotive demand did not expand.
quarterly_data.figure: Asia ex-Japan net sales JPY 24,259 million (+33.0%); Japan JPY 25,906 million (+15.5%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Union Tool annual securities report: FY2025 (03-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 R&D expenses JPY 2,341 million. In PCB drills the company focused on ULF-coated drills for FC-BGA package substrates for AI servers and data centers and for high-layer-count motherboards: it developed high-aspect-ratio drilling technology for the next-generation multilayer core direction in FC-BGA packages, a dedicated small-diameter router for cavity machining to embed components in inner-layer cores, and technology for thicker high-layer-count motherboards with the application of quartz glass cloth in mind. Carbide end mills: added UDCSB and UDCSLB to the diamond-coated UDC series and developed CLRS for steel.

quarterly_data.quarter: Union Tool annual securities report: FY2025 (03-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management states the new generative AI field is expected to create large related demand, and since the company makes its own production equipment it intends to use that strength to increase production capacity rapidly; going forward it will strengthen its supply system for high-quality products for advanced electronic components such as semiconductor packages, adding production equipment and installing the latest equipment to raise productivity.
